item.title: Lebanon ceasefire falters as Trump pushes for Iran deal
item.description: Israel is “deepening its operation” in Lebanon, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said.

item.title: After stern words from Trump, U.S. and Iran trade strikes
item.description: The renewed violence came after the president said Iran was wrong if it thought he would feel pressure to make concessions and resolve the standoff before U.S. midterm elections later this year.
